newsitem.title: USA: Scitex names interim CEO of U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Scitex names interim CEO of U.S. unit.

text.p: Israel-based Scitex Corp Ltd on Tuesday said it named Shlomo Shamir interim president and chief executive officer of Scitex America Corp.
Shamir was previously corporate vice president of operations.
Patrick Kareiva, current president and CEO of Scitex America, resigned to pursue other interests following a corporate restructuring, the company said in a release.

Scitex America, with headquarters in Bedford, Mass., is responsible for distribution and customer support for Scitex in North and South America. Scitex Corp makes visual information communication products for the graphic arts, digital-printing and digital video markets.
